title: Loki's Revenge
description:
After eons of being imprisoned by the Asgardian gods for his crimes and trickery, Loki has broken free and unleashed his army of loyal monsters to bring about Ragnarok in order to terrorize the realms and take revenge against the Norse gods. Fight back as one of your favorite gods to defeat Loki, his army, and avoid Ragnarok!

Loki's Revenge is a short survivors-like - it can be fully completed within a few hours.

Defeat Loki's Loyal ArmyDraugrs, ogres, wolves, and the Jotnar - they all fight for Loki and must be stopped! Defeat wave after wave of large hordes of monsters and bosses. Some monsters will chase you down relentlessly; others will try to shoot you with arrows and other projectiles. Learn how they attack and avoid getting hit!

Master each god's unique abilityEvery god has their own, unique ability you can activate. Thor uses his lightning powers to double all of his stats, Sif channels the energy of the Bifrost to heal herself, and Odin summons Geri and Freki to mow down enemies. Each god's ability creates unique play styles!

Level Up and Gain Powerful BoonsWhen defeated, enemies will drop XP. Collect enough and you'll level up and get to choose from 3 powerful Boons! Boss enemies will also drop a Bifrost Shard that gives you access to unique Boons. Some Boons boost your stats, some give you new ways of attacking enemies and dealing damage. Collect as many as you can to build the ultimate overpowered god! 

Permanently Upgrade Your CharacterGods never die! After dying or completing a run, you'll have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned Gold on permanent upgrades. Permanently boost stats for all gods to even the odds for future runs. 

Completing certain objectives and earning achievements will also permanently unlock new characters to play as, as well as new Boons that will be added to the level up pool.

Explore Midgard to find hidden upgradesHidden within Midgard are powerful Boons and challenges. Once you find them, they'll be permanently added to your available pool of Boons for future runs. 

Features• 4 playable Norse god, each with unique stats and active abilities

• 25+ Boons

• Permanently upgradable stats

• 1 map to explore with secret unlockable Boons & challenge areas

• 22 Achievements

• Vengeance levels - after successfully completing a run, you can choose to play the map again with all your boons and an increased difficulty level
description_short: Loki’s Revenge is a short survivors-like roguelite where you play as Norse gods fighting Loki’s army of monsters! Level up to gain powerful upgrades and explore a hand-crafted map to find secrets. Build the ultimate overpowered god with permanent upgrades and master each god’s signature ability.
